@@name@@Playful@@icon@@Playful.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Fizz''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target location while becoming [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], balancing on his trident for 0.75 seconds, during which he can cast ''[[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]]'' after 0.15 seconds into the duration.@@description2@@He then begins to hop off of his trident over 0.5 seconds, during which he gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 50% '''bonus''' movement speed, and afterwards becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals magic damage to nearby enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them for 2 seconds.@@description3@@''While hopping off of the trident, '''Fizz''' may input movement commands to direct his landing.''@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@

@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 375@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@75 / 80 / 85 / 90 / 95@@cooldown@@16 / 14 / 12 / 10 / 8@@targeting@@Location@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. *''Playful'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **Detonating the ability early for [[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]] does not. * The distance covered during ''Playful's'' directed splash is equal to half of '''Fizz's''' movement speed. * ''Playful'' cannot be used for approximately 0.5 seconds after using [[File:Fizz Urchin Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Urchin Strike|An icon for Fizz's ability Urchin Strike]] [[Fizz#Urchin Strike|Urchin Strike]]. * [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] can be used while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it. * '''Fizz''' can receive aggro while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it * If the first dash is interrupted, '''Fizz''' initiates the hop immediately, and if the second one is, the splash will not occur. ** In either cases, '''Fizz''' loses the untargetability. [https://youtu.be/Zjtcee-OvUQ] (unexpected)[[Category:Unexpected behaviours]] * If ''Playful'' is cast while under the effect of a move block, '''Fizz''' will not become untargetable and will initiate the hop instantly.(bug) ** If [[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]] is cast, the splash will not occur.(bug) * If '''Fizz''' casts ''Playful'' on top of himself after [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinking]] and not moving from the blinked-to spot, the minimum dash distance of 25 units will not apply (casts at 0 range).(bug) * If '''Fizz''' enters [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|stasis]] during either ''Playful'' or [[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]], the splash occurs after the stasis ends.@@

@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 225@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@{{{cast time}}}@@cost@@{{{cost}}}@@cooldown@@{{{cooldown}}}@@targeting@@Location@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. * ''Trickster'' does not count as an ability activation. * Both [[File:Fizz Playful.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Playful|An icon for Fizz's ability Playful]] [[Fizz#Playful|Playful's]] and ''Trickster's'' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] may be directed separately. * [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] cannot be used during the dash. * The splash occurs immediately if '''Fizz''' encounters terrain that cannot be dashed through (he has to be particularly close to the wall).@@
